about_the_game:
This is a DLC that allows you to enjoy 4 additional civilizations in 4X4 PROGRESS!
Enjoy the atmosphere and game style of the newly added civilizations, and progress from the Stone Age to the Modern Era once again.

Includes 4 new civilizations.

  • Norway: A civilization that starts at sea and gains resources by defeating enemies. Unique tiles include Langskip and Stave Church.
  • India: A civilization for experienced players who can recover HP instead of starting with -2 combat power. Unique tiles include Mandir and Electronics Factory.
  • Brazil: A civilization with abundant food, including the indestructible Amazon tile. Unique tiles include Coffee Farm and Cristo Redentor.
  • Thailand: A civilization with special gameplay that can capture elephants and use them for battle. Unique tiles include Wat and Buddha Statue.
